sources.title: [26.18] Lord of Top Lane; A Darius Guide (Jungle Guide Included; WIP)

passive.name: Hemorrhage
passive.text: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

spells.name: Decimate
spells.text: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

spells.name: Crippling Strike
spells.text: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

spells.name: Apprehend
spells.text: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

spells.name: Noxian Guillotine
spells.text: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

damage.value: Darius deals sustained physical damage through Hemorrhage and burst true damage with Noxian Guillotine.

archetype.value: Darius is a bruiser who pulls enemies close, stacks Hemorrhage, and finishes them with Noxian Guillotine.

axis.value: Darius can play for early all-ins with Flash and Ignite, a setup listed for massive early kill pressure.

winCondition.value: Darius wins team fights by waiting for initial abilities and crowd control to be used, then flanking to catch enemies off guard.

spikes.why: Darius gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.
Darius can use its briefly refreshed cooldown to strike again.

bait.why: After Darius uses Apprehend, its pull is unavailable until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Darius risks getting locked down when he enters a team fight before initial abilities and crowd control have been used.
Darius loses Decimate damage and healing when he hits with the handle instead of the blade.
